details:
1. Create a group on VRChat Home website

2. Create a group+ instance under that group from VRChat client

3. Find the group ID from the VRChat Home website, and an invite link to an instance (e.g.: https://vrchat.com/home/launch?worldId=wrld_4432ea9b-729c-46e3-8eaf-846aa0a37fdd&instanceId=47931~group(grp_62f3c45c-e1f7-4311-a87e-82d5bcf92df4)~groupAccessType(plus)~region(eu))

4. Invite yourself from the invite API with your group's ID (use the above URL as an example for format), but do not join the instance

5. Check your invite and view instance details, you should see the instance with 0 people in it, under your group name

6. Delete the group you've just created

7. (Optional) View the instance details again, you'll see a cached result with the group name

8. Close the VRChat client and quickly reopen it, to ensure no cached data persists in memory (required)

9. Once reopened, invite yourself back into that instance from the same URL

10. View the instance details from the new invite; if done correctly (quickly enough), the group name will be your group name instead of placeholder text "Owners"; if the group name is "Owners", you were too slow.

11. Click your group name from that instance's details in VRChat client

12. Observe the group details UI break as shown in the screenshots. The group shortcode (MUGI.5819) in that view won't also match any known group or your group's shortcode.
title: Broken group details UI while viewing a deleted group page
